name: devkit
description: A small, opinionated kit for building software with Claude Code: process skills, a delegation policy that keeps token use down, repository setup, and third-party plugins pinned to a commit.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: On in every repository: grill-me, grilling, handoff, fable-orchestration, repo-setup, and a session-start hook that shows the repository's progress notes.

plugins.name: ui
plugins.description: For repositories with a user interface: frontend-design, webapp-testing.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: obra/superpowers v7.0.2, pinned to a commit. Process skills and the session-start skill check.
